name: basis
description: Design with Basis from any repo: the product's design system, screens designed for an issue, their verification kit, and basis-diff, Basis' own check that the product matches the design.

basis_url.title: Basis URL
basis_url.description: Where Basis answers. Leave empty for a Basis on this machine (http://localhost:5320).

basis_api_token.title: Basis API token
basis_api_token.description: Basis' BASIS_API_TOKEN. Leave empty for a Basis on this machine, which keeps its own in ~/.basis/api-token.

basis_project.title: Basis project
basis_project.description: The project that designs for this product, by id or name. Leave empty when Basis has one project.
